findings.issue: My earlier recommendation was wrong, and the change made to follow it should be undone. 'חתום בראשי חרוזים אלעזר בירבי קליר' cannot describe Tair. tair_vetaria.xml is a single line (תָּעִיר וְתָרִיעַ … קָדוֹשׁ) with no acrostic, and it has no internal copy of the attribution. The first letters of the Adderet Mamlakhah tercets spell א-ל-ע-?-ר-ב-י-ר-ב-י-ק-י-ל-י-ר (אַדֶּרֶת, לְבֵל, עָלֶיהָ, [וַכְלִילֵי], רָחֲבָה, בְּעַתַּתָּהּ, יְסוֹדוֹת, רֹאשׁ, בְּעָרְמָה, יְרִיעוֹתַי, קַנְיָנוּת, יוֹזְמֵי, לְהָצוֹת, יָהֲרָה, רָם). That is אלעזר בירבי קליר, so the note describes Adderet. Adderet sits outside every Metz scope. With the note now inside the Metz Tair conditional, a metz=true documentary edition loses the attribution while still printing the poem it describes.
findings.recommendation: Move :412 out of the Metz conditional. Put it after :413's endConditional (or after :414's closing </tei:div>) and before the adderet_mamlakhah/part_1 transclusion at :415, still inside the weekday shabbat=false scope. That way it prints whenever Adderet prints and never on Shabbat. This is a description-note move only and changes no identity or prayer words.
